evidence: The original task specifies one object per run containing the listed fields, including usage state, plus the damage reason for a damaged run.
Q-001's proposed shape makes only damaged optional; R-002 likewise says each object has the listed fields.
candidate.md, FACT-013 and S-001 actions 2–3, instead omit every field except id, status and damaged for damaged runs. S-002 action 3 explicitly tests that attempts is absent.
cmd/shogun/stats.go:70–73 represents unavailable damaged-run values with '-' cells; it does not remove their columns.
findings.problem: Damaged-run objects omit required per-run fields. Executing the plan would produce a different object shape for damaged runs, without mode, models, counters, cost or usage state, contradicting R-002 and the proposed Q-001 shape.
findings.requested_change: Keep the declared fields on damaged-run objects, representing unavailable values explicitly, for example with null rather than fabricated zero counters. Revise FACT-013, the JSON types and the damaged-run assertions accordingly.

summary: The plan otherwise covers the flag, totals, unchanged text output and read-only behavior. Revise the damaged-run schema to preserve the required fields.
